title: Watch ‘Goth Baddie’ Pinkchyu’s Mom Get Emotional After Hearing Drake’s Buying Her a New House
summary: Drizzy made the promise after Pink won the "wife" award at his 20-vs-1 speed-dating competition.
contentText:
Drake promised cosplayer Pinkchyu she could have anything as a gift after the 6 God picked the “goth baddie” as his wife during Drizzy’s 20-vs-1 speed-dating competition over the weekend.

Related

Drake Submits to ‘Goth Baddie’ Streamer Who Gets Him to Bark on Command: ‘Good Boy’

Everything We Learned From Drake’s 9th Anniversary Stake Livestream

Drake Cleverly Interpolates His Own ‘MAID OF HONOUR’ Track on New Karol G Collaboration ‘Ahí’

Pink, who lists her name as Lin Lamar on Instagram, posted a heartwarming clip on Tuesday (Aug. 12) featuring her mom’s reaction to hearing Drake is going to be buying her a brand new house.

“The first thing that came to mind was everything you’ve done for me and my sisters, and he’s gonna buy you a house,” Pink told her mom, who was left completely shocked on the couch.

The streamer’s mom nearly broke down before the matriarch responded, “Are you serious? Oh my God! I can’t believe it!”

Pink’s post to IG has earned more than 240,000 likes as she put the whirlwind of the last few days in perspective with her caption: “I’m so grateful for everything that has happened that past few days. Thank you so much Drake and thank you to all the wonderfully kind I’ve met.”

Pinkchyu made it to the final three of the 20-vs-1 dating game for Drake alongside influencer Jordyn Lucas and adult-film star Lena the Plug. Lucas was named Drizzy’s “bestie,” which earned her a new Hermès Kelly bag and $25,000, while Lena the Plug took home $25,000 and a dream vacation for securing a win in the “pipe” category.

Pink scored the ultimate prize of whatever her heart desired, as she seemed to have a leg up on the competition, being the “goth baddie with absolute O-cups” that Drake has been attempting to manifest.

Drake hosted Stake’s 9th anniversary livestream on Kick on Saturday night (Aug. 8), which featured plenty of highlights, including Drizzy showing love to Tate McRae, sending a warning shot at the rest of hip-hop and revealing Father Duck was his first MSN Messenger username.

However, the most viral moment from the entire livestream came when Pink had Drake bark for her on command after they just met. Pink also followed up with a video post to IG on Wednesday (Aug. 12), bragging about being Drake’s type of woman. “Can you blame em,” she quipped as she she showed off why he may be a fan of hers.

2026 has already been a busy year for the 6 God, who delivered his trifecta of albums in May, which saw ICEMAN , HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR take the top three spots of the Billboard 200.
